scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run setup:deps
scripts.setup:env: npm run setup:env:frontend && npm run setup:env:backend
scripts.setup:env:frontend: copy Client\StreamNestAIClient\.env.local Client\StreamNestAIClient\.env || cp Client/StreamNestAIClient/.env.local Client/StreamNestAIClient/.env
scripts.setup:env:backend: copy Server\StreamNestAIServer\.env.local Server\StreamNestAIServer\.env || cp Server/StreamNestAIServer/.env.local Server/StreamNestAIServer/.env
scripts.setup:deps: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:cloudflare
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:cloudflare"
scripts.start:cloudflare: cd MCP-and-CDN && npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd Server/StreamNestAIServer && go build -o bin/streamnest-server main.go
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:cloudflare
scripts.clean:frontend: cd Client/StreamNestAIClient && rm -rf node_modules dist || rmdir /s /q node_modules dist 2>nul
scripts.clean:backend: cd Server/StreamNestAIServer && rm -rf bin || rmdir /s /q bin 2>nul
scripts.clean:cloudflare: cd MCP-and-CDN && rm -rf node_modules .wrangler || rmdir /s /q node_modules .wrangler 2>nul
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.logs:all: concurrently "npm run logs:backend" "npm run logs:frontend" "npm run logs:cloudflare"
scripts.status:services: curl -s http://localhost:8080/health && echo '\n--- Frontend ---' && curl -s http://localhost:5173 | head -n 5 && echo '\n--- Cloudflare Worker ---' && curl -s http://localhost:8787
scripts.health: npm run health:backend && npm run health:frontend && npm run health:cloudflare
scripts.health:backend: curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || echo Backend is not responding
scripts.health:frontend: curl -f http://localhost:5173 || echo Frontend is not responding
scripts.health:cloudflare: curl -f http://localhost:8787 || echo Cloudflare Worker is not responding
